links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified UK NHS hospital online patient information on labour epidurals
links.outcome: Readability of patient education text (mean grade level and proportion of texts meeting the sixth-grade target on two readability scores)
links.effect: Mean grade fell from 8.4 ± 2.1 to 7.7 ± 1.2 (P <0.001). Texts meeting target went from 14.5% and 23.2% to 24.6% and 27.5% on the two scores.
links.tradeoff: ChatGPT-rewritten texts still did not reach the sixth-grade target. Most texts still missed it on both scores, and the mean grade stayed above target.
links.quote: After AI-modification, 24.6% and 27.5% of the texts met targets using the same metrics, with the mean grade (7.7 ± 1.2) decreasing significantly (P <0.001), but still not meeting the target level.

design_hint: reading-level constraint via prompting ChatGPT to rewrite patient materials
